ideas.title: The Last Library Book
ideas.one_sentence_premise: A librarian discovers a single, blank book that writes its own story each time it's opened.
ideas.twist: The final page reveals the reader's own name, implying the book has been writing their life all along.

ideas.title: Mirror Messages
ideas.one_sentence_premise: Two strangers in different cities receive identical notes reflected in their bathroom mirrors each morning.
ideas.twist: The notes are generated by an AI that predicts their meeting; the last note shows a live video feed of the other person brushing their teeth.

ideas.title: The Unsent Letter
ideas.one_sentence_premise: A woman finds a sealed envelope in her late grandmother's coat pocket, addressed to a future date.
ideas.hook: "Do not open until the day you forget me."
ideas.twist: When the date arrives, the letter contains a QR code linking to a video of the grandmother explaining a family secret that changes the woman's identity.
